_comment: Edit these lists to tune VivoType's transcript cleanup. 'fillers' are removed as whole words (case-insensitive). 'replacements' map a spoken/misrecognized term to its correct form. Currency conversion ($->INR) is handled in code, not here. 'profiles' defines optional named contexts (per-app rules via Settings): each may set convert_currency/remove_fillers (default true) and extra 'replacements' that override the ones above. Map apps to profiles in VivoType's Settings; unmapped apps use the top-level rules.
